lines.beaver_en: Don't you feel the neighborhood is a bit unsafe lately?
lines.learner: 네, 저도 걱정돼요. 무슨 일 있었어요?
lines.en: Yes, I'm worried too. Did something happen?
lines.roman: ne, jeodo geokjeongdwaeyo. museun il isseosseoyo?

lines.beaver_en: I heard some houses got robbed.
lines.learner: 저도 작년에 자전거를 도둑맞은 적 있어요.
lines.en: I had my bike stolen last year, too.
lines.roman: jeodo jangnyeone jajeongeoreul dodungmajeun jeok isseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Oh no, what did you do then?
lines.en: I reported it to the police station and joined crime-prevention patrols.

lines.beaver: 와, 주민이 직접 참여할 수 있군요.
lines.beaver_en: Wow, residents can take part directly.
lines.beaver_roman: wa, jumini jikjeop chamyeohal su itgunnyo.
lines.learner: 네, 저는 공군에서 경호 일을 해서 관심이 많았어요.
lines.en: Yes, I did security work in the air force, so I was very interested.
lines.roman: ne, jeoneun gongguneseo gyeongho ireul haeseo gwansimi manasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Security? Impressive. Who did you protect?
lines.learner: 장군 경호를 맡은 바 있어요. 국방부 행사였어요.
lines.en: I guarded a general. It was a defense ministry event.
lines.roman: janggun gyeonghoreul mateun ba isseoyo. gukbangbu haengsayeosseoyo.

lines.beaver: 그럼 경찰이랑 같이 일하신 적도 있어요?
lines.beaver_en: Then have you also worked with the police?
lines.beaver_roman: geureom gyeongchalirang gachi ilhasin jeokdo isseoyo?
lines.learner: 국방부와 경찰청이 함께 훈련한 바도 있어요.
lines.en: The defense ministry and police have trained together.
lines.roman: gukbangbuwa gyeongchalcheongi hamkke hullyeonhan bado isseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Do you think our neighborhood needs security guards?
lines.learner: 경호보다 이웃끼리 서로 지키는 게 중요해요.
lines.en: Neighbors looking out for each other matters more.
lines.roman: gyeonghoboda iutkkiri seoro jikineun ge jungyohaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: I see. Is there anything else to prepare?
lines.en: Installing a motion-sensor light at the entrance is also good.

lines.learner: 네, 한 달에 두 번 골목을 돌아요.
lines.en: Yes, I walk the alleys twice a month.
lines.roman: ne, han dare du beon golmogeul dorayo.

lines.beaver_en: Hearing that puts my mind at ease. Thank you.
lines.learner: 다음 주민 모임 때 같이 이야기해요.
lines.en: Let's talk more at the next residents' meeting.
lines.roman: daeum jumin moim ttae gachi iyagihaeyo.
